command:
cd /Users/dct/code/EllyaOrg/projects/dalimaray/observatory-wt/current && cat > /tmp/msg-green.txt <<'EOF'
fix(core): hosted plan.revised from the session file

The hosted stream has no notification for Droid's todo_state record, so a hosted
run lacked the plan.revised events the attached view has (VAL-HOST-014, hosted 18
against attached 21 in round 2 of m2-host-shell-and-launch).

RpcMapper::with_session_files makes the mapper read the hosted child's session
file, found below [ingest].factory_sessions_dir by the session id the
droid.initialize_session response names, and map its todo_state records through
the same mapping v1 state as the stream. They are fed in file order, before the
first stream line that carries a later time, and the rest at finish. The events
keep the session file's pointers, so they have the ids the attach path gives the
same lines, and mapping v1 reports a plan only when it differs from the one
before, so a plan in both sources or a file read twice maps once. A file that is
rewritten in place or not there yet is handled without repeating an event.

The golden file is unchanged.
EOF
git interpret-trailers --in-place --if-exists addIfDifferent --trailer "$(cat .git-trailers)" /tmp/msg-green.txt && git add crates/observatory-core/src crates/observatory-core/tests/rpc.rs && git commit -q -F /tmp/msg-green.txt; git log -1 --format='%h %s'; git log -1 --format='%(trailers:key=Co-authored-by)'; git status --short
